title: FDA MAUDE data platform change being monitored
summary: On 23 October 2026, the main public safety databases remain available with no confirmed disruption to searches. FDA has announced that MAUDE adverse-event data will move into its Adverse Event Monitoring System during 2026; the existing MAUDE public data service remains available today, and we are monitoring FDA notices for any change that could affect data freshness or access.
updates: FDA: MAUDE data is planned to become available in AEMS during 2026. No date or public search-service change has been announced. [FDA MDR data files](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/medical-device-reporting-mdr-how-report-medical-device-problems/mdr-data-files)
no_major_changes: FDA Recall and Safety Communications, BfArM, Swissmedic, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada, PMDA, AEMPS, ANSM, and NMPA English showed no meaningful public-source setup or access changes.
